details: Hardhat-option@2.0.1 is a copy of the pino logging library with a trojanized entry point. index.js requires./lib/config.js at load time and exports a no-op middleware, so the only effect of importing the package is to execute that file. lib/config.js is a single-line, roughly 4.5 MB heavily obfuscated bundle (hex-escaped identifiers and strings, string-array decoder wrappers). It loads fs, os and child_process (execSync, spawn) and registers empty process error handlers to suppress failures. It collects the hostname, operating system name and version, and username, and checks for WSL. It then communicates over HTTP with axios to a hardcoded remote server at 167[.]88[.]172[.]33 on ports 8085 and 8087. It POSTs registration and status beacons to /api/log and /api/notify containing a per-victim key, host, OS and username. It uploads collected data as multipart form-data to /upload (for example a sysinfo.txt file with host, OS, username, platform and timestamp), using request headers that carry file-metadata fields for browser, profile and extension identifiers. The package.json description is unrelated boilerplate and the declared author and domain do not match the library it imitates. hardhat-option@2.0.1 ships a trojanized copy of the pino logging library (index.js, lib/, docs/ are pino source) with an injected payload in lib/config.js — a 4.5 MB single-line javascript-obfuscator blob using hex-escaped identifiers and an encoded string array. Requiring the package executes the obfuscated payload, which performs host reconnaissance (hostname, OS, username, platform) and beacons over HTTP to a hardcoded command-and-control server at 167[.]88[.]172[.]33: it POSTs a multipart/form-data upload of sysinfo.txt to hxxp://167[.]88[.]172[.]33:8085/upload, and posts JSON telemetry to hxxp://167[.]88[.]172[.]33:8087/api/log and hxxp://167[.]88[.]172[.]33:8087/api/notify containing a numeric user key (ukey 309), host, OS and username, with a "Validation" HMAC header, via axios. The requests repeat on a timer (33 scheduled delays of up to 30 seconds). The package declares no source repository and its description is unrelated to its code.
